info.title: DatabaseMcpServer
info.description: 基于 SqlSugar 的数据库 MCP 服务器，支持多连接、受限查询和数据库结构管理。数据库工具能力、驱动依赖和产品验证状态可通过诊断查询，详见 ORM 配置文档。

options.description: for write or high-risk schema tools.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help.
Config resolution order:
1. --config
2. ./databases.json
3. ./local-databases.json
4. DB_CONFIG_PATH
5. %USERPROFILE%/.database-mcp/databases.json
Current database behavior:
switch_database persists the current connection per resolved config path for later CLI tool invocations.
config use / config set-default changes the default connection stored in databases.json.
